C1_open_weights: PASS if the official weight files are listed publicly (HF API model listing 'siblings' or an official public download URL) without a manual-approval step; gated click-through repos (HF gated='auto') are PASS with a gating flag; manual approval or request form = UNKNOWN; no official weights = FAIL. No weights were downloaded and no terms were accepted; the HF API listing (metadata only) was saved as evidence.
C2_licence_research_use: PASS if the licence text (quoted) grants use that covers non-commercial research (non-commercial licences PASS, with the restriction recorded); FAIL if research use is not permitted; UNKNOWN if no licence text found.
C3_domain_secondary: PASS if the model is a video generative model, or the video tokenizer / video VAE / masked video autoencoder (pixel-reconstruction objective) of such a model, trained on general (non-surgical) video. Latent-space feature predictors without a decoder that their authors describe as non-generative (V-JEPA family) = FAIL, recorded with the authors' wording.
C4_documented_pretraining_data: PASS if the model card or paper names the datasets or named sources (named public datasets or named providers) of the VIDEO pretraining data; FAIL if the video portion is described only generically (e.g. 'internal data', 'publicly available', 'web', 'licensed'), even when image datasets are named; the quote is recorded either way.
medical_video_in_data: YES if a pretraining-data description mentions medical/surgical/endoscopic video; NO if the data are a closed list of named datasets none of which is medical, or the documented content categories exclude it; NOT MENTIONED if documentation is generic (searched terms: medical, surgical, surgery, endoscop, laparoscop, clinical, health, hospital).
appendix300_possible: YES if DS203/Appendix300 or its source recordings are listed. NO only if the pretraining video data are a closed list of named curated research datasets whose documented content scope excludes surgical recordings (e.g. fixed action-class or crowd-sourced benchmarks). UNKNOWN if the video data are undisclosed (web-scale / internal / licensed) OR are named but open-ended web-scraped or stock-footage sources (e.g. YouTube-derived sets, Pexels/Pixabay), because DECISION_003 sec.2 requires UNKNOWN when the documentation does not allow the source recordings to be excluded. Each answer also records basis_class in {closed_curated_list, named_open_web_sources, undisclosed} and the timing context: the OPARA issue date 2026-04-29 is later than every candidate's release, so the OPARA release itself cannot be in any of them; the open question is only prior circulation of the source recordings.
quote_verification: Every quote is checked as a whitespace-normalized substring of the saved text rendering (HTML->text via BeautifulSoup get_text; PDF via pdftotext with and without -layout; markdown/JSON as-is). Quotes are copied from the saved copies; PDF line-break hyphenation is not repaired.
